response.sql: SELECT AVG(invoice_mean_price) AS avg_of_invoice_means, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.product_price) AS invoice_mean_price, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number HAVING AVG(ili.product_price) IS NOT NULL) AS invoice_stats

assumptions.assumption: Both metrics apply to the same filtered set of invoices—those with at least one non-NULL product_price. Invoices with all NULL prices are excluded from both the average of means and the average line-item count.

alternatives.interpretation: The average number of line items per invoice applies to all invoices with at least one line item in Invoice_Line_Items, not filtered to those with non-NULL prices. Only the average of means excludes invoices with all NULL prices.
alternatives.sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(invoice_mean_price) FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.product_price) AS invoice_mean_price FROM Invoices i JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number HAVING AVG(ili.product_price) IS NOT NULL) x) AS avg_of_invoice_means, (SELECT AVG(line_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) y) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice
